Aligned sequence distance using BSD4 substitution costs (C++ implementation)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
rcpp_blosum_sequence_distance.Rd

Computes the total BSD4 distance between two pre-aligned amino acid strings of equal length. Matches blosum_sequence_distance() in rconga/R/tcr_distances.R exactly.

Usage

rcpp_blosum_sequence_distance(seq1, seq2, gap_penalty = 4)

Arguments

seq1

Character string. Aligned sequence (may contain " ", ".", or "*").

seq2

Character string. Aligned sequence of the same length as seq1.

gap_penalty

Numeric. Applied when exactly one position is a gap or stop-codon character. Default 4.0 matches GAP_PENALTY_V_REGION.

Value

Numeric scalar: sum of per-position BSD4 distances.

Details

Position handling:

  • Both characters are " " (space): position skipped (padding). The function stops with an error if only one character is a space.

  • Both characters are "." (gap): distance 0.

  • Both characters are "*" (stop codon): distance 0.

  • One character is "." or "*": gap_penalty.

  • Both are valid amino acids: BSD4 lookup from the constexpr table.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  rcpp_blosum_sequence_distance("ACDE", "ACDF")
} # }
